authoring_review.reason: Inspected original body with the complete single ocular/compact barrel/chain in SEN and explicit west, mask-off/on ownership, cyan C/white Y independent palette and 48x96 intended-size views. Context output shifted the body/item and invented a top knob; only recorded grayscale metal samples are used on original constructed contours. Generated body, knob and halo are excluded. Glass/chain/hidden item surfaces remain explicit authored geometry, and original head occludes rear/far-side parts only at composition. No extra isolation or native acceptance is claimed.

Inspected male single-ocular/barrel/chain in four cardinal facings, original-head late visibility, C/Y palette and intended-size views. Full canonical item/detail share one uniform head-relative scale/translation per facing, preserving optical proportions and body contact. Target rear/far-side head pixels are original male anatomy, not a transformed female head. Source refinement is reused truthfully with no new call; actual Argyve Face/0 metadata retained. Explicit-west runtime binding and outfit acceptance remain pending.

scope: All two enumerated Face/0 authoring fits reuse the same complete ocular/barrel/chain; male fit has target-original head-relative controls and visibility. No actor or native acceptance completion claimed.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set gate, explicit-west direction binding and combined outfit precedence
